source: Archives of Nethys — Starfinder 2e Tech Core
note: Full Tech Core descriptions; rules only for explicitly audited passive abilities. Other abilities require manual resolution.

entries.name: Accompanist
entries.description: Your familiar helps you perform. Whenever you attempt a Performance check, if your familiar is nearby and can act, it accompanies you with chirps, claps, or its own miniature instrument. This grants you a +1 circumstance bonus to the check or +2 if you're a master in Performance.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries.description: It gains the amphibious trait, allowing it to breathe in both air and water, and has both a land Speed and a swim Speed, each equal to its highest land Speed or swim Speed.

entries.name: Burrower
entries.description: It gains a burrow Speed of 5 feet, allowing it to dig Tiny holes.

entries.name: Climber
entries.description: It gains a climb Speed of 25 feet.

entries.name: Construct
entries.description: Your familiar has the construct trait instead of the animal trait. The familiar is immune to death effects, disease , doomed , drained , fatigued , healing , nonlethal attacks, paralyzed , poison , sickened , spirit , unconscious , vitality , and void . Your familiar must have the tough pet ability to select this.

entries.name: Damage Avoidance
entries.description: Choose one type of save. Your familiar takes no damage when it rolls a success on that type of save; this doesn't prevent effects other than damage.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries.description: It gains darkvision .

entries.name: Dragon
entries.description: Your familiar has the dragon trait instead of the animal trait.

entries.name: Echolocation
entries.description: It can use hearing as a precise sense within 20 feet.

entries.name: Elemental
entries.description: Your familiar has the elemental trait instead of the animal trait. Choose air , earth , fire , metal , water , or wood . Your familiar gains that trait. The familiar is immune to bleed, paralyzed , poison , sleep , and the element matching its trait. Your familiar must have the resistance familiar ability to select this ability.

entries.name: Fast Movement
entries.description: Increase one of the pet's Speeds from 25 feet to 40 feet.

entries.name: Flier
entries.description: It gains a fly Speed of 25 feet.

entries.name: Focused Rejuvenation
entries.description: When you Refocus, you generate magical energy that heals your familiar. Your familiar regains 1 Hit Point per level whenever you Refocus.

entries.name: Fungus
entries.description: Your familiar has the fungus trait instead of the animal trait.

entries.name: Independent
entries.description: In an encounter, if you don't Command your familiar, it still gains 1 action each round. Typically, you still decide how it spends that action, but the GM might determine that your familiar chooses its own tactics rather than performing your preferred action. This doesn't work with valet or similar abilities that require a command, if you're capable of riding your familiar, or similar situations.

entries.name: Kinspeech
entries.description: Your familiar can understand and speak with animals of the same species. To select this, your familiar must be an animal, it must have the speech ability, and you must be at least 6th level.

entries.name: Manual Dexterity
entries.description: It can use up to two of its limbs as if they were hands to perform manipulate actions.

entries.name: Master's Form
entries.description: Your familiar can change shape as a single action, transforming into your ancestry with the same age a clearly unnatural remnant of its nature, such as a cat's eyes or a serpent's tongue. This form is always the same each time it uses this ability. This otherwise uses the effects of humanoid form, except the change is purely cosmetic. It only appears humanoid and gains no new capabilities. Your familiar must have the manual dexterity and speech abilities to select this.

entries.name: Partner in Crime
entries.description: Your familiar is your criminal associate. Despite being a minion, your familiar gains 1 reaction at the start of its turns, which it can use only to Aid you on a Deception or Thievery skill check (it still has to prepare to help you as normal for the Aid reaction). It automatically succeeds at its check to Aid you with those skills or automatically critically succeeds if you're a master of the skill in question.

entries.name: Plant
entries.description: Your familiar has the plant trait instead of the animal trait.

entries.name: Plant Form
entries.description: Your plant familiar can change shape as a single action, transforming into a Tiny plant of a type roughly similar to the familiar's nature. This otherwise uses the effects of one with plants. You must have a familiar with the plant trait to select this ability.

entries.name: Resistance
entries.description: Choose two of the following: acid, cold, electricity, fire, poison, or sonic. Your familiar gains resistance equal to half your level (minimum resistance 1) against the chosen damage types.

entries.name: Scent
entries.description: Your pet gains scent as an imprecise sense within 30 feet.

entries.name: Skilled
entries.description: Choose a skill other than Acrobatics or Stealth . Your familiar's modifier for that skill is equal to your level plus your spellcasting attribute modifier, rather than just your level. You can select this ability repeatedly, choosing a different skill each time.

entries.name: Speech
entries.description: Your familiar understands and speaks a language you know.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description: Choose a spell in your repertoire or that you prepared today at least 5 ranks lower than your highest-rank spell slot. Your familiar can Cast that Spell once per day using your magical tradition, spell attack modifier, and spell DC. If the spell has a drawback that affects the caster, both you and your familiar are affected. You must be able to cast 6th-rank spells using spell slots to select this.

entries.name: Toolbearer
entries.description: Your familiar can carry a toolkit of up to light Bulk. So long as your familiar is adjacent to you, you can draw and replace the tools as part of the action that uses them as if you were wearing them. Your familiar must have the manual dexterity ability (page 79) to select this ability.

entries.name: Touch Telepathy
entries.description: Your familiar can telepathically communicate with you via touch. If it also has the speech ability, it can telepathically communicate via touch with any creature if they share a language.

entries.name: Tough
entries.description: Your pet's max HP increase by 2 per level.

entries.name: Valet
entries.description: You can command your familiar to deliver you items more efficiently. Your familiar doesn't use its 2 actions immediately upon your command. Instead, up to twice before the end of your turn, you can have your familiar Interact to retrieve an item of light or negligible Bulk you're wearing and place it into one of your free hands. The familiar can't use this ability to retrieve stowed items. If the familiar has a different number of actions, it can retrieve one item for each action it has when commanded this way.

entries.name: Cantrip Connection
entries.description: You can prepare an additional cantrip or, if you have a repertoire, designate a cantrip to add to your repertoire every time you select this ability; you can retrain it but can't otherwise change it. You must be able to prepare cantrips or add them to your repertoire to select this ability.

entries.name: Familiar Focus
entries.description: Once per day, your familiar can use 2 actions with the concentrate trait to restore 1 Focus Point to your focus pool, up to your usual maximum. You must have a focus pool to select this ability.

entries.name: Innate Surge
entries.description: Once per day, you can draw upon your familiar's innate magic to replenish your own. You can cast one innate spell gained from an ancestry feat that you've already cast today. You must still Cast the Spell and meet the spell's other requirements.

entries.name: Lifelink
entries.description: If your familiar would be reduced to 0 HP by damage, as a reaction with the concentrate trait, you can take the damage. If you do, you take all the damage and your familiar takes none. However, special effects that would occur due to that damage (such as snake venom) still apply to your familiar.

entries.name: Share Senses
entries.description: Once every 10 minutes, you can use a single action with the concentrate trait to project your senses into your familiar. When you do, you lose all sensory information from your own body but can sense through your familiar's body for up to 1 minute. You can Dismiss this effect.

entries.name: Spell Battery
entries.description: You gain one additional spell slot at least 3 ranks lower than your highest-rank spell slot; you must be able to cast 4th-rank spells using spell slots to select this ability.

entries.name: Spell Delivery
entries.description: If your familiar is in your space, you can cast a spell with a range of touch, transfer its power to your familiar, and command the familiar to deliver the spell. If you do, the familiar uses its 2 actions for the round to move to a target of your choice and touch that target. If it doesn't reach the target to touch it this turn, the spell has no effect.

entries.name: Vital Bond
entries.description: Your familiar in your mystic bond can use Transfer Vitality once per minute to heal itself or a bonded creature.
entries.sourceNote: AON currently joins Vital Bond to the end of Spell Delivery; separated here without changing the rule text.
